_gap: Nine of the entries above share one cause: the run wrote its result into
CHECKLIST.md or EXPERIMENT_LOG.md and left no JSON behind. Those logs are now
the only surviving copy of those numbers.
That is the same failure as +492.60 with the opposite cause. There a number
was invented and the source discarded; here the source was discarded and the
number kept. Registering these is not making them verified - it is recording
The fix is a harness writing _results.json beside its output, which
docs/pipeline/README.md already asks for and which these runs skipped. Until
then EXPERIMENT_LOG.md is a second home for numbers, and that is the thing
